item.title: Tyson Foods Pleads Guilty and Agrees to Pay Fine for OSHA Violation That Led to Worker Death
item.description:
Energy and Natural Resources Division, ENRD - Environmental Crimes Section:

WASHINGTON—Tyson Foods Inc. pleaded guilty today in U.S. District Court in Arkansas and agreed to pay the maximum fine for willfully violating worker safety regulations that led to a worker’s death in its River Valley Animal Foods (RVAF) plant in Texarkana, Ark., the Justice Department announced.
